statement: For sufficiently large Λ, the conically modified base operator has the following estimates. 1. Bounded-frequency estimates with weaker compact errors persist uniformly as Λ → ∞, at the orders and zero-frequency weights of Proposition 4.1. The stationary index is zero, and kernel and cokernel are upper semicontinuous. On closed bounded bands excluding zero, the physical estimates persist without compact error, up to Re ζ ↓ 0. 2. For every fixed strip 0 ≤ Re ζ ≤ D∗ and fixed admissible order, there are polynomial high- frequency bounds without kernel, with threshold independent of sufficiently large Λ. These include the compact Hs estimate from Hs−1, for s = 5 or a fixed higher admissible order, the supported dual solution estimate of order 1 − s, and ⟨r⟩−1/2−ι (v, ∂yv) ∈ L2 for the physical transpose with a compact smooth source, with polynomial frequency cost. 3. Zero-frequency estimates, including those for gauge potentials, persist uniformly for nearby exact Kerr principal metrics in smooth stationary, asymptotically affine charts of the prescribed 24 type. Fixed smooth finite-dimensional supplements remove their kernel and cokernel locally in parameters. The same-sign outgoing transpose has the a priori estimate and index stated in Lemma 4.4.
